verdict.rationale: Segment documents pipeline-style automations that keep running once configured: Reverse ETL syncs warehouse query results to third-party destinations, Audiences built from events and computed traits sync to hundreds of destinations, and Functions run custom JavaScript sources and destinations without extra infrastructure. These are rule-based data flows rather than agentic automations, and the evidence never describes schedules, triggers, or autonomous AI-driven workflows. Missing for 10: explicit scheduling/trigger documentation, AI-agent-driven or goal-based autonomous automations, independent or hands-on corroboration of background execution.
